query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    d.departamento_key,
    g.diagnostico_key,
    CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112)) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112)) END AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) END AS dias_estancia
FROM silver.admissions a
JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
     ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
JOIN gold.dim_departamento d
     ON d.nombre_departamento = a.department
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT admission_id, icd_code, severity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY admission_id ORDER BY diagnosis_id, icd_code) AS rn
    FROM silver.diagnoses
) dx ON dx.admission_id = a.admission_id AND dx.rn = 1
JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico g
     ON g.codigo_icd = COALESCE(dx.icd_code, 'N/A')
    AND g.nivel_severidad = COALESCE(dx.severity, 'Unknown')',
